item.title: Bulletin updated at 09:05 HKT 27/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will bring generally fine and very hot weather to southeastern China today and tomorrow. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week. It will still be hot over the region. The subtropical ridge is expected to cover southeastern China again midweek next week.

Date/Month: 27/06 (Thursday)
Wind: East to southeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine apart from one or two showers. Isolated thunderstorms at first. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 34 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
